# Repertoire

Repertoire is a package manager for portable AI agent skills (SKILL.md
packages). One command installs a skill from a Git-backed catalog into the
native skills directory of every supported coding agent (Codex, Claude Code,
Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf, and 25 more), tracks each copy by
digest so local edits are never overwritten, and reproduces a team's setup
from a committed repertoire.yaml. Skills install under the home directory by
default; --project installs into the current Git worktree. The built-in
catalog includes a "repertoire" skill that teaches coding agents to operate
Repertoire, write manifests, and scaffold new skill catalog repositories.
